title: Feedback On First Round of Agentic Game Marketing
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
So I've been doing game marketing for about 3 years know, having help indies make close to $1 million their first year, work with a lot influencers, built tooling around it and other stuff.

Being a developer myself, I love how I enter a prompt in AI and just does it. Now I want to do that with marketing.

You ask it for the best subbreddits, to making social content, even to find influencers an invite them to play your game, and does all of that for you.

This is my first release of it and I'll appreciate the feedback on how it better help you market your games: [https://www.glitch.fun/publishers/agents](https://www.glitch.fun/publishers/agents)
